findings.evidence: Full pytest reset event logs; body attempts no longer silently reuse numeric result paths. Scope subprocess test reruns same output with changed failing body.
Body NameError/KeyError classified as behavior failures, not automatically fixture failures; tested backend classification.

Removed hardcoded 51-module/three-crash/120-second claims from report generator. Further work: report merges multiple body directories and identifies current native hash at reporting time rather than executed-native hash; must retain per-attempt provenance and refuse incompatible mixes.

Several historical original-body runners independently implement decorator stripping, fixture injection and result aggregation; some omit class lifecycle/marks. Isolated bodies must remain labelled and must never count as equivalent pytest coverage. Consolidate current runner selection/attempt schema; preserve historical evidence.

hl.dtype('struct{`é`: int32}') returns field name Ã©. Parser encodes already-decoded Unicode as UTF-8 bytes and applies unicode_escape to all bytes. Local Hail utils.java::unescape_parsable has the same implementation: inherited Unicode behavior, not evidence that Vail uniquely introduced the shortcut. Vail codepoint contract should preserve literal Unicode.
findings.acceptance: Parse escape sequences without corrupting literal Unicode; preserve non-ASCII codepoints and escaped backticks/backslashes, reject malformed escapes.

findings.evidence: Importing types.py replaces pprint.PrettyPrinter process-wide with a subclass of its current value. This modifies unrelated callers and repeated module reload can chain incompatible printer subclasses.
findings.acceptance: Use a scoped pretty-print integration or explicitly justified registration preserving other caller behavior; test import/reload and unrelated nested objects.

findings.evidence: Array.index maps integer indices and captures full input array; array arithmetic maps indices and captures both input arrays. Native lambda captured arrays are repeated per lane, causing avoidable quadratic copying.
findings.acceptance: Native zip/enumeration of child values; preserve lengths/missingness/errors and callback RNG semantics, show linear input processing.

findings.evidence: ir_view::table recursively materializes every child into dictionaries, with no memo or node references; a union repeatedly duplicating the same child can expand a shared relational DAG exponentially.
findings.acceptance: Bounded summary or DAG-aware diagnostic graph with explicit node references; no implicit execution or serialization required for inspection.

findings.evidence: _key_filter_intervals calls eval on scalar/global-dependent bound expressions while constructing Table.filter, before an action. filter_intervals also localizes expression-valued interval collections at construction.
findings.acceptance: Carry typed bound expressions into native logical/action parameter phase; no data-source reads during transformation construction; prove counters remain zero until action.

findings.evidence: Python independently recognizes key comparisons and reconstructs locus/contig intervals, duplicating provider/interval_read native algebra. Matrix filter_intervals validates through a discarded row-table result and then builds a per-row OR of interval predicates rather than carrying the interval-read node.
findings.acceptance: One native typed bound algebra and logical interval filter preserving file pruning through table/matrix transformations. Prove impossible segments not opened, not partition counts.

findings.evidence: _referenced_columns, _validate_aggregate_ir, _ir_has_aggregate and bind.check_scope recursively visit every edge without native-node memoization; NativeExpr wrappers are recreated for children. Shared x=x+x graphs can expand paths exponentially despite fixed native identity hashing.
findings.acceptance: Native DAG-aware analysis with lexical/aggregate context in visited keys; deterministic unique-node work-count regressions.

findings.evidence: Table._generate constructs contexts.flatmap(rowfn) into one array expression and only then requests n partitions through parallelize_expression. Need verify source execution does not first materialize all generated rows in one singleton array. Confirmed ExpressionSourceExec collects one singleton array and caches all output rows before slicing it across source partitions.
findings.acceptance: Inspect/measure peak memory and first-batch latency for large generated data; native context-partition streaming producer if singleton materialization confirmed.

findings.evidence: _axis_aggregates constructs a separate entry context/grouped aggregate/lookup for each aggregate subtree/field. Identical context Arc sharing alone does not guarantee common execution.
findings.acceptance: Fuse compatible column aggregates under one native grouped aggregate and one join; count source reads for increasing output fields.

findings.evidence: choose_cols calls count_cols, union_rows counts and collects both column key lists during transformation construction. Native column-global dependencies may include prior row aggregations.
findings.acceptance: Native lazy validation in the action graph, with explicit metadata actions only where schema fundamentally depends on values (make_table).

findings.evidence: show obtains headers from matrix.cols().collect() (key sorted) but cell values from localized row slots (physical column order). choose_cols with reordered keys can label values with the wrong sample, same pattern as fixed VCF export bug. Reproduced headers0.x/1.x with values11/10 after choose_cols([1,0]); now headers follow owning slot order, regression passed.
findings.acceptance: Read bounded headers from owning column_records in slot order; test reversed/duplicate selections and nontrivial keys.

findings.evidence: Column explode constructs range(length(values)).map(lambda j:struct(index=j,value=values[j])), capturing complete array per lane; same quadratic lambda-copy pattern fixed for zip/index.
findings.acceptance: Native indexed zip/enumerate of values with linear work and stable occurrence identities.

findings.evidence: to_matrix_table resolves last duplicate coordinate through agg.collect(entry)[-1], retaining every duplicate payload when only one result is needed.
findings.acceptance: Shared ordered last-value accumulator with bounded state and deterministic source order; count retained bytes for many duplicates.

findings.evidence: filter_entries projects only _ROW/_CELLS, unlike annotate_entries which preserves hidden row_index_keys. Core index/order metadata is discarded before later row predicates, potentially losing pruning.
findings.acceptance: Preserve certified row-key columns/order through entry-only transformations; verify impossible files remain unopened after filter_entries followed by key filter.

findings.evidence: run_all_tests.classify python_tests returns passed for code0 without any recognized pytest outcome count, unlike Rust/native/oracle branches which require evidence. Summary parsing depends on the last stdout line.
findings.acceptance: Use structured pytest outcomes or require valid explicit summary; absent/malformed successful evidence cannot become a passing suite. Test empty stdout and trailing plugin diagnostics.

findings.evidence: profile_annotate/profile_samples/profile_cloud wait indefinitely for ready/go/worker report while a native worker remains alive. profile_samples does not terminate worker in a finally block on monitor errors; counters can fail while query continues.
findings.acceptance: Explicit run deadline and owned process-group cleanup on monitor failure/cancellation; distinguish timed-out work from reported throughput.

findings.evidence: Historical inventory renderers embed fixed primitive/unsupported storage and array claims, independent of runtime evidence. Dedicated remaining count subtracts body_results over all rows rather than restricting the same dedicated scope. Preserve pinned source count guards, but derive support claims and denominators from matching evidence.
findings.acceptance: Separate historical source requirements from current implementation evidence; counters filtered to identical scope, no hardcoded current support claims.
